summary: Frontend-only layout verification of PAUSE three-cell badge (Tipo · Categoria · Durata) on the Home discover feed and the reader-ending 'Continua con' badge. Measured pixel positions of icon vs text label across multiple categories (Space / Human Body / Nature / Science / Money & Economics / Animals) by swiping the deck. In every observed cell the icon container is a fixed 36 px wide box, the icon fits within it (no clipping), and there is a clear horizontal gap of 7.5 px (category) or 9.0 px (kind/time) between the icon's right edge and the label's left edge. No icon→text overlap found. In reader-ending BadgeIcons, the 3 wraps are each 36×32, with 10 px gap to the 1 px dividers, no icon spilling into neighbour's divider. Fix is working as intended. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: story-info-grid.tsx line 105: iconWrap width is a fixed 36 px which matches the widest category image (CATEGORY=27 × aspect 1.3 ≈ 35.1 px). Measured width of category icon in DOM = 35.0 px, so there is a ~1 px safety margin — tight but sufficient; keep an eye on future category art with wider aspect.
reader-ending.tsx line 305: badgeIconWrap { width: 36, height: 32 } matches story-info-grid, consistent sizing — good. Divider gap of 10 px on each side keeps icons from touching the divider line.

Non-blocking: console warnings 'textShadow* style props are deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' appear from LinearGradient/StoryHero usages — React Native 0.75+ deprecations, unrelated to this task.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest flow: Continue as guest → tap topic chips (Animals/Space/…) → Start discovering → discover deck. Badge testIDs on home are 'home-story-meta' (current card) + '{storySlug}-slot-N-meta' (next). Children: -kind, -kind-icon, -kind-value (same for category/time). Reader-ending next badge testID: 'next-badge-icons' with child testIDs 'next-badge-icons-{kind|category|time}'. To reach reader-ending: open a story (tap title), then scroll with page.mouse.wheel(0,2000) ~20 times until '[data-testid=next-badge-icons]' is visible; use scroll_into_view_if_needed. Olografico theme toggle lives deeper in Profile (needs scrolling past Content/My Interests sections); not reached in this run but code paths share the same 36-px iconWrap so layout is identical by construction.
rca_of_issue: N/A — verification task, nothing to fix. Measurements: Home badge → kind icon 32×32 in 36 wrap, gap 9.0 px to label; category icon 35×27 (planet/paw/plant/flask/heart/stacked coins) in 36 wrap, gap 7.5 px to label; time icon 32×32 in 36 wrap, gap 9.0 px to label — zero overlap in all cases. Reader-ending badge → three 36×32 wraps separated by 1×18 dividers at x=201 and x=258; icons rendered at x=157/212/271 fully contained inside their wraps (overflow_left=false, overflow_right=false) with ≥10 px gap to dividers.
